title: com.ottoyard.vehicle.fault.summary (operator to OTTO-Q)
description: The operator's own reading of a fault: its severity and category. Raw codes may ride along in fault_codes and are never interpreted. takes_vehicle_offline is the one signal that lets OTTO-Q end a charge short or route the car straight to a service stall or long-term staging (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

fault_codes.description: The operator's own fault codes, proprietary or OBD-II, stored as sent and never interpreted: OTTO-Q acts on severity, category, services_needed and takes_vehicle_offline.
